properties.name: kolaboro:method
properties.value: Observed, not declared: scripts, stylesheets and fonts loaded by Chromium on 20 key pages at 390 and 1440 px, plus every <script src> and <link rel=stylesheet|preload> tag in the HTML of the 199 sitemap pages (199 fetched), plus the worker source files. Each file was downloaded once to compute its hashes.

properties.name: kolaboro:worker_note
properties.value: The kolaboro.com part of the Cloudflare worker (36 files: the shared router index.js, kolaboro.js and the kbx feature modules) is plain ES modules with no npm imports. The same worker also serves other sites from separately built bundles that are loaded only for those hosts; they are outside this bill of materials, and hosts called only by the shared router are not listed as services.
